description: A circular walk through two of Oxfordshire's historic park estates. You'll start off in the village of Glympton and pass through the Glympton Park Estate. On the way you will enjoy views of the River Glyme and the 18th century Glympton House. The walk then heads north west towards Kiddington where you'll find Kiddington Hall. The hall dates back to 1673, and includes some beautiful gardens laid out in the 18th century by "Capability" Brown. On the trail there's also some splendid views of the surrounding Cotswolds Hills and countryside. To continue your walking in the area you could head east to visit Rousham Park .
